Usage: seek add [<path>] [flags]

Add a collection to index

Arguments:
  [<path>]    Directory to index

Flags:
  -h, --help              Show context-sensitive help.
      --version           Show version and exit.

  -n, --name=STRING       Name of the collection (defaults to folder name)
  -p, --pattern=STRING    Glob pattern for markdown files (default: **/*.md)
      --type=STRING       Collection type: markdown|code|documents|pdf|images
      --agent=STRING      Agent: claude|codex|opencode|copilot|zed|hermes
                          (claude/codex are native)
      --claude            Add Claude Code conversations (~/.claude/projects/)
      --codex             Add Codex conversations (~/.codex/)
      --images            Add an image directory (png/jpg/webp)
      --pdf               Add a PDF directory (rasterized for VL embedding)
      --code              Add a source code repository directory (Go, Rust,
                          Python, TS/JS, etc)
      --documents         Add a documents directory via the extraction backend
                          (docx/xlsx/pptx/epub/html/...)
      --docs              Shortcut alias for --documents
      --parser=STRING     Add a schema-driven parser collection (e.g. opencode,
                          copilot-cli, zed)
      --opencode          Shortcut for --parser opencode
      --copilot           Shortcut for --parser copilot-cli
      --zed               Shortcut for --parser zed
      --hermes            Shortcut for --parser hermes (Hermes Agent state.db)
      --claude-schema     Shortcut for --parser claude (schema-driven,
                          text-only)
      --codex-schema      Shortcut for --parser codex (schema-driven, text-only)
      --backend=STRING    Override the extraction backend (builtin|xberg)
